name: clock-reset-2008
description: Six hours on a 0.85 U/hr profile with a pump reset 180 minutes ago: its clock restarts at 2008-01-01 00:00 and its uptime at 0, it forgets its IOB and last bolus, it writes NewDay, ArmInit and VersionInfo records and no TimeChanged or DateChange, and it keeps delivering. A 2.0 U pump bolus 240 minutes ago on the old clock and a 1.0 U one 90 minutes ago on the 2008 clock; the pump ends in 2008 by its clock, so the app has to set it. About 0.7 U IOB, the later bolus's.
